description: This Mendeley version 2 deposit provides eight files used to size an off-grid electricity system for Fouay village in Benin. The producer lists local load assessments from an onsite survey, meteorology from the nearest Kandi station, estimated flow at the Cascade de Sosso hydropower site, component costs and specifications, and HOMER optimisation and simulation outputs. The load workbook separates household, community and commercial demand with assumed seasonal profiles. The public release is CC BY 4.0 and includes spreadsheets, two CSV output tables and a survey document. This is one village planning case, not observed performance of an installed hybrid plant or a measured village-wide hourly load history. Estimated river flow, survey assumptions and seasonal load construction are limitations for transfer to another site. A reviewer-assessed use is testing hybrid PV, diesel, battery and hydropower sizing under revised costs or demand. platform-homer-hybrid-power-modeling is the related software used in the study; no rerun or source-cell audit was performed. Five rejected round-one candidate versions describe the same release family, and their single-site exclusion conflicts with the current reuse rule.
